name: cool-mode
blurb: Particles spawn and drift away when clicking or hovering.
description: Attaches particle emitter to DOM elements. Particles spawn on click/hover, drift upward with horizontal sway, and rotate. Uses SVG or custom particles.
use_when: Interactive celebrations, playful CTAs, or engagement-focused UI.
a11y: Particle overlay; decorative only. Does not affect interaction.
